CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

2. Which response best shows understanding of Use of Natural Resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Use of Natural Resources.
   B. Use Use of Natural Resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Use of Natural Resources has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Use of Natural Resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
   A. Say Bible Translation has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Translation.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Translation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Bible Translation to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Leadership in Israel? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leadership in Israel.
   B. Say Leadership in Israel has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Leadership in Israel to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Leadership in Israel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Functions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Functions of the Bible.
   B. Use Functions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Functions of the Bible has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Responsibility over Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Use Responsibility over Plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Responsibility over Plants.
   D. Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of John the Baptist to the Messiah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing John the Baptist to the Messiah.
   B. Use John the Baptist to the Messiah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say John the Baptist to the Messiah has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Stewardship over Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stewardship over Creation.
   B. Apply the teaching of Stewardship over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Stewardship over Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Stewardship over Creation has no place in daily life.

11. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

12. Which response best shows understanding of Divisions of the Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Say Divisions of the Bible has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Divisions of the Bible.
   C. Apply the teaching of Divisions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Divisions of the Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Social Media and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Accounts of Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Stewardship over Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. C — Apply the teaching of Functions of the Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of Responsibility over Plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Apply the teaching of John the Baptist to the Messiah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. A — Apply the teaching of Importance of Studying Christian Religious Education with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Apply the teaching of Stewardship over Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
